headline: President Bush changed an earlier executive order that set up a performance-based organization to run air traffic services within the FAA.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13180, a 2000 order that created an Air Traffic Performance-Based Organization inside the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA). The title does not say what was changed. No summary was provided, so the specific changes cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules for the organization that runs air traffic services, but the exact changes are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely when signed on June 4, 2002, though the source material does not say.
